# montecarlo_mulesoft_credentials (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `app_client_id` (String) Client ID of the Anypoint connected app. The app needs the View Environment, Read Deployments and Exchange Viewer scopes.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `org_id` (String) Anypoint organization or business group to collect from. Set it when your Mule applications are deployed in a business group. Leave it out to collect the organization that owns the connected app. Null unless set.
- `region` (String) Anypoint Platform instance the organization lives on.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
